---
title: "Stage 7.2 — Benchmark patch/PU lookup library"
output: html_document

params:
  config_file: "config/madagascar.yml"
  mode: "inspect"             # inspect | resume | restart
  optimization_curves: null   # null = all completed Stage 6 curves
  rank_method: "abf"          # abf | caz1 | caz2 | cazmax
---

Stage 7.2 reconstructs one benchmark method at the exact retained-cell counts
required by completed Stage 6 curves. `resume` preserves compatible lookups and
builds only missing counts. `restart` deliberately deletes and rebuilds only
the selected method library.

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
source(file.path("R", "stage72_workflow.R"))
rmd_options <- project_rmd_params("7.2_build_rank_lut.Rmd")
configured <- rmd_project_config(rmd_options, "stage72")
rmd_params <- configured$params
config <- stage72_lookup_config(rmd_params)
target_plan <- stage72_target_plan(config)
```

```{r inspect}
stage72_readiness <- inspect_stage72(config, target_plan)
print(stage72_readiness)
```

```{r lookup-library, message=TRUE, warning=FALSE}
if (config$mode %in% c("resume", "restart")) {
  stage72_lookup_status <- run_stage72(config, target_plan)
  print(as.data.frame(stage72_lookup_status[setdiff(
    names(stage72_lookup_status), "counters"
  )]))
}
```

```{r artifact-summary}
stage72_index <- benchmark_library_index(config, target_plan, validate = TRUE)
print(stage72_index)
cat("Runtime log:", config$paths$reconstruction_log, "\n")
```
